subject: general
question: India's services exports achieved above ______ billion for the first time during April-March 2021-22.
solution:
The correct answer is** '$250'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India's Services exports set a new record of **USD 254.4 Billion** in the financial year 2021-2022.
 
• The new record achieved in 2021-22 beats the previous high of USD 213.2 Billion in 2019-20. 
 
• Services exports hit an all-time monthly high of USD 26.9 Billion in March 2022.
 
• India's merchandise export in 2021-22 (April-January) was **USD 335.44 billion**, an increase of 46.53% over USD 228.9 billion in 2020-21 (April-January) and an increase of 27.0% over USD 264.13 billion in 2019-20 (April-January).
 
• India has achieved monthly value of merchandise export in May 2022 amounting **USD 37.29 billion**, an increase of 15.46% over USD 32.30 billion in May 2021. 
 
• India's merchandise export in April -May 2022-23was USD** 77.08 billion **with an increase of **22.26% over USD 63.05** **billion** in April -May 2021-22.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Selling products and services to a foreign country is referred to as exporting.
 
• Contrarily, importing is the act of acquiring goods from outside and bringing them into one's own nation.
 
• Additionally, it is separated into Direct and Indirect categories.
 
• The expected value of services exported between April and December 2022 is $235.81 billion, up from $184.65 billion during the same time last year, according to data from the Commerce Ministry.
 
• These exports reached a record high of $254 billion in 2021–22.
